entities.summary: Isaac Ben-Israel is an Israeli military scientist, general, politician and state official. From 2005 to 2022, he served as the chairman of the Israeli Space Agency and the National Council for Research and Development, under the auspices of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Space of Israel. He finished his service in the IDF ranked General, serving as head of the military Administration for the Development of Weapons and the Technological Industry. Between 2010 and 2012 he served as chief Cybernetics adviser to PM Netanyahu, during which period he founded the National Cyber Bureau in the PM office and launched the National Cyber Initiative.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As chairman of the Israeli Space Agency and National Council for Research and Development, Ben-Israel played a key role in shaping Israel's technological advancements, including its space program. His work as chief Cybernetics adviser to PM Netanyahu led to the launch of the National Cyber Initiative, significantly enhancing Israel's cybersecurity capabilities.
